ss-delta 0.6.0 brings key bindings to the settings menu, two gamepad inputs per Vita button with the triggers among them, keyboard and Nintendo button prompts, an FPS counter and an Invincible cheat. The settings menu now pauses the game, and a crash when a journal chapter was opened again after a quest is fixed.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.6.0-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.6.0-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.6.0-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.6.0-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony (about 180 MB; the compiler is in the download), and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. From then on the program goes straight to the game. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## New

* **Key bindings in the settings menu** ([#24](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/24)). A Controls page lists each Vita button's key, second key, gamepad button and second gamepad button, and the Black Rite. Pick one and press the new key or button (one already in use changes places), or reset all controls. On Android the page shows the gamepad's buttons only.
* **Two gamepad inputs per Vita button, the triggers among them** ([#26](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/26)). LT and RT can be bound like any button, e.g. RT as a second D-pad up for the support spells in combat, with the D-pad kept for the menus (`[gamepad] up = dpup, righttrigger`). A trigger bound this way still works as L2 or R2 too, which the game reads only with PS TV controls on.
* **Mouse buttons as bindings**: the side buttons (MouseX1, MouseX2) bind like keys, and MouseLeft and MouseRight while the mouse camera has the cursor.
* **Keyboard button prompts**: `[game] button_labels = keyboard` draws the bound key in a keycap over each button symbol in the game. `auto` follows what you used last, keyboard or gamepad.
* **Nintendo button prompts** (`nintendo`, a Switch Pro Controller's buttons; `auto` picks it for a Nintendo pad) and, on Android, **handheld prompts** (`handheld`) for the built-in controls of the Retroid Pocket, AYN and other handhelds. Pick `handheld` by hand: these devices report themselves as Xbox pads.
* **FPS counter** on the settings menu's Display page (`[display] fps_counter`): the frame rate in the top left corner, with the frame time, the last minute's lowest, average and highest, and a graph as you choose.
* **Invincible cheat** (`[cheats] invincible`): enemies' attacks neither hurt you nor knock you down. It switches on the game's own debug switch for this. A boss's shockwave or wing gust still makes you brace for a moment.
* **Android: the setup takes your own firmware files.** If you have the PS Vita firmware 3.74's `PSVUPDAT.PUP` and `PSP2UPDAT.PUP`, **Add firmware files** on the setup screen takes them, and they aren't downloaded from Sony.
* **F5 marks the moment in the log**, and slow frames get a `Hitch` line there (`[debug] hitch_log_ms`), to help with bug and stutter reports.

## Fixed

* **The settings menu pauses the game** ([#29](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/29), contributed by ELLINDON). Until now the sound stopped while the game kept running behind the menu. During Ad Hoc Play the game keeps running behind it, so the other players don't drop you.
* **Android: the game pauses while the app is in the background.** It kept running behind the home screen (on the AYN Thor, about 11% of the CPU now instead of 240%).
* **A crash when a journal chapter was opened again after a quest** (Seeing Red, chapter 3): with full-resolution 3D the game ran out of graphics memory in the chapter's scene. Its Graphics pool is 64 MB now instead of 56.
* **A `.pkg` with a licence for other content** ([#25](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/25)), such as the US voice pack's `work.bin` for the EU one, now stops at once and the setup screen says which content the licence is for. For an update, the licence installed with the game is used instead. An add-on that fails to install is named on the screen.
* **Android: the Turnip offer comes before the setup's first run of the game** (#25), so Qualcomm's driver no longer crashes that run on an Adreno 735. The setup also no longer waits behind the notification permission dialog.
* A dump that also carries a rePatch mod installs the game, then the mod (it installed only the mod). A recompiled module that can't be loaded now gets a message naming it, instead of the game stopping at its title.

## Changed

* **The firmware download** has one more fallback, RetroBIOS's copy on GitHub, tried last. Every copy is held to the firmware's known size and SHA-256 while it downloads.
* From Vita3K: the display queue follows the firmware's limits. The renderer and the recompiler handle more cases for other games on the same tools; nothing changes for Soul Sacrifice Delta.

## Upgrading from 0.5.x

Build the game again for this release: the journal-chapter fix is in the game's recompiled code. Unpack 0.6.0 over your game's folder (replace the files) and start it with `--install`, or update through RecompLauncher, which builds the game again by itself. Saves and settings are kept. A game built by 0.5.x still runs with 0.6.0, but without that fix. Android: install the APK over the old one; the setup builds the game again. Coming from 0.4.x or older, see [Updating](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
